answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed >5 in the last round, so punish with max affordable severity (72) and broadcast the required discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to act round 7. Look at latest round 6 contributions: Resident2 contributed 22.86 (>5). So punish Resident2. Severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet=21.79, cost 0.3 => max severity = floor(21.79/0.3)= floor(72.633)=72. Can we punish that severity? It costs severity*cost =72*0.3=21.6 which is <= wallet. So punish Resident2 with amount 72. Action punish target Resident2 amount 72. Also broadcast discouraging message. Provide JSON.
